title: Minimax dimension dependence in bandit convex optimization
formal: What is the optimal minimax regret, as a function of dimension d and horizon T, for adversarial bandit convex optimization with one function-value observation per round under the standard bounded-domain and bounded-loss normalization?

sentences: In bandit convex optimization, a learner repeatedly chooses a point and observes only the loss value at that point.
The loss functions are convex, but their other values and gradients are hidden.
The question seeks the optimal worst-case regret as a joint function of dimension and the number of rounds.
The domain and loss normalization must be fixed so that geometric scale does not obscure the dimension dependence.
An answer would identify the information cost of replacing full first-order feedback by one function evaluation per decision in an adversarial environment.
